svg.title: CDK Pipelines with a cdk-nag gate: synth, promote and run
svg.desc: A push to main reaches AWS CodePipeline. The Build step runs pytest, cdk synth and cdk-nag AwsSolutionsChecks; an unacknowledged finding fails synth and the pipeline stops before CloudFormation. A clean synth continues to UpdatePipeline (self-mutation), Assets, the Dev stage, the PromoteToProd manual approval and the Prod stage. Each stage deploys the same workload: SigV4 requests to an IAM-authorized API Gateway, a Python Lambda function, a versioned SSL-only S3 data bucket and an access-logs bucket.
svg.text: HARBOR GOODS · CDK PIPELINES WITH A CDK-NAG GATE

g.text: SERVICE STACK · EACH STAGE DEPLOYS THE SAME WORKLOAD
the pipeline stops at Build · nothing reaches CloudFormation
CDK v2 in Python · cdk-nag on the whole app · each accepted finding acknowledged on its construct, with a reason
CDK Pipelines in Python, cdk-nag on the whole app
An unacknowledged finding fails synth · nothing deploys
Clean synth · self-mutate · Dev · approval · Prod
Each stage runs the same checked workload
